title: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer expected to top the US box office this weekend
summary: Forecasters expect an opening of $20 million to $25 million.
body:
Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol, starring Johnny Depp, is expected to be the number one film in North America this weekend, according to box office forecasters.

Trade publication Boxoffice Pro predicts the Paramount film will take between $20 million and $25 million in its first three days. Other forecasters put it at about $21 million to $22 million.

The competition

Last weekend's number one, Godzilla Minus Zero, is forecast to come second with $12 million to $17 million. The heist comedy How to Rob a Bank also opens this weekend.

The picture changes next week, when The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping arrives.

These figures are forecasts, not results. Sources: Boxoffice Pro, Box Office Report.
